turns.user_utterance: I believe my card has been stolen, what can I do about this situation? It's urgent.
turns.assistant_response: I’m sorry—let’s handle this urgently. It sounds like your card may be stolen. Please confirm: do you still have access to your account/app? If yes, immediately lock the card in the app (or in your Cards section). If you don’t have access, tell me that and I’ll guide you on the fastest way to secure your account and arrange the next steps.
